# Moonlit Paths of Faith
## Scripture
"For we live by faith, not by sight." - 2 Corinthians 5:7

## Reflection
As we gaze up at the night sky, the phases of the moon remind us of the seasons of our faith journey. Just as the moon waxes and wanes, our faith can experience times of growth and times of uncertainty. Yet, even in the darkest phases, the moon is still present, reflecting the light of the sun. Similarly, even when our faith is challenged, God's presence remains, guiding us through the darkness. The moon's consistent cycles reassure us that our faith, too, will go through seasons, but God's faithfulness endures.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, as we navigate the phases of our faith, remind us that You are always present, even when we can't see You. Help us to trust in Your faithfulness and guidance, just as the moon trusts in the sun's light. May our faith be strengthened by the assurance of Your presence, and may we reflect Your light to a world in need. In Jesus' name, we pray, Amen.
